conversation_starters.title: Invasive bamboo gets a second life helping animals at San Antonio Zoo
conversation_starters.summary: Light, novel local feel-good story — invasive bamboo repurposed as zoo animal food. Prime work-safe opener. You could open with: 'Did you hear the San Antonio Zoo is feeding its animals bamboo pulled from Brackenridge Park?'
conversation_starters.description: Brackenridge Park Conservancy is removing invasive bamboo and partnering with San Antonio Zoo to turn it into food and enrichment for animals.

you_should_know.title: Most San Antonio school districts head into a new school year with budget deficits
you_should_know.summary: Metro-wide school-district financial condition — most SA districts entering the year with deficits. Not state-level but broad local institutional context worth walking in aware of; not a check-in event. Keep as you-should-know.
you_should_know.description: Out of a dozen school districts in San Antonio, only three are likely to balance their budget for the upcoming 2026-27 school year. you_should_know.title: Kerr County records seventh rabies case after skunk found in family's yard
you_should_know.summary: Public-health condition — seventh rabies case in Kerr County (in-region for SA metro). A standing local hazard worth walking in aware of; not a discrete exposure event that lands on the reader, so not are-you-ok. Keep as you-should-know.
you_should_know.description: A skunk killed by family dogs has been classified as a positive rabies case under Texas law, bringing Kerr County's total to seven this year.
